withdrawal of mid-day meal scheme.

The Government should reconsider its decision of withdrawal of mid-day meal scheme.
(II)
The Governmentt should close down some of the municipal schools.
(III) The Government should carry out a detailed study to find out the reasons for school
dropouts.
